description:
The four solver binaries in outram-foam-cli/src/bin (pimple_foam, rho_central_foam, rho_pimple_foam, sonic_foam) each carry a private run(), control_from_case(), time_span(), find_scalar()/find_vector() and fmt_time(). That is the case-driving glue -- FoamCase dir -> ControlDict -> configured solver -> time loop -> write fields -- duplicated four ways and reusable from nowhere. src/lib.rs is 111 lines of arg parsing only.

Lift it into a library API (run_case-style) so the same path is callable from Rust and, via the outram-park Python wheel, from Python. The binaries become thin wrappers; the solvers themselves already exist as libs in outram-foam-appbuilder-lib/src/solvers and need no porting. Examples and tutorials stay as they are -- they already consume the lib solvers.

Related: outram-park (parent repo) gh:#3 covers the pyo3 generator gaps that block any of this from reaching Python.
title: outram-foam: lift the CLI case-driving glue into a reusable lib API

description:
docs/verification-and-validation.md 4.6 and tests/angle_of_repose.rs both record
'this crate: 12.78 deg' against LIGGGHTS' 15.43 deg, to four significant
figures. That number cannot be reproduced, and never could have been.

PROVENANCE, established 2026-09-18:
  - 12.78 was recorded in commit ad8e99cf4b (2026-09-16).
  - At that commit granular_system.rs:359 read
        let mut cells: HashMap<(i64,i64,i64), Vec<usize>> = HashMap::new();
    and the pair-enumeration loop iterated that map directly.
  - std::collections::HashMap seeds its hasher RANDOMLY PER PROCESS. Force
    accumulation is floating point and addition is not associative, so cell
    visit order changes the sum, and the case is chaotic over 1.1e6 steps.
  - The current source says so itself, in the corrected doc comment at
    granular_system.rs:811-813.
  - The deterministic counting-sorted cell list that fixed it landed in
    213c994f5b (2026-09-17), AFTER the number was recorded.

So 12.78 deg is ONE DRAW from a per-process-random distribution. A second run
of the very binary that produced it would have given something else.

WHY THIS MATTERS BEYOND THIS NUMBER: it was not labelled as a draw. It sits in
a V&V table beside genuinely bit-identical results (the primitive-wall cases
agree to 1-3 ulp), formatted identically, so a reader cannot tell which numbers
are reproducible and which are samples. The 2.65 deg 'gap' against LIGGGHTS was
then reasoned about as though it were a stable measurement, and a mechanism
(single-nearest-facet mesh contact) was attributed to it.

ALSO IN SCOPE: every other number in this crate's V&V record produced between
cb4f01f709 (2026-09-15, HashMap introduced) and 213c994f5b (2026-09-17, fixed)
is under the same doubt and should be audited. The CLAUDE.md already notes
htr10_settled_ours.csv 'could not be regenerated exactly' for this reason.

DELIVERABLE: re-measure the repose case on the deterministic build, record the
new number WITH its reproducibility status, and mark every figure in the
09-15..09-17 window as either re-measured or still-suspect. Do not silently
overwrite 12.78 with a new number -- the fact that it was irreproducible is
itself the finding.
title: liggghts: the recorded 12.78 deg angle of repose is IRREPRODUCIBLE by construction -- produced under op-t3l.9 nondeterminism
